property_summary: For every call to play() the reference contract requires msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT so pot either increases exactly by TICKET_AMOUNT or is reset to 0 after a win; the mutant allowing msg.value >= TICKET_AMOUNT can accept smaller-than-ticket payments which leads to pot differing (not equal to multiples of TICKET_AMOUNT) after some inputs, breaking the invariant that after any play the pot is either 0 or a multiple of TICKET_AMOUNT.
change_summary: Replace the require checking exact msg.value with a check that allows smaller payment by requiring msg.value >= TICKET_AMOUNT, which can change pot accumulation and thus pot after play.
